mapper.select: SELECT ( #{beginCreateTime} + bucket * #{intervalSeconds} ) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(numeric_value) AS numeric_count, MIN(numeric_value) AS min, MAX(numeric_value) AS max, AVG(CASE WHEN numeric_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ABS(numeric_value) >= 1e154 THEN numeric_value / 1.7976931348623157e308 ELSE 0.0 END) * 1.7976931348623157e308 + AVG(CASE WHEN numeric_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ABS(numeric_value) < 1e154 THEN numeric_value ELSE 0.0 END) AS avg FROM ( SELECT FLOOR(DATEDIFF(SECOND, #{beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, create_time) / #{intervalSeconds}) AS bucket, numeric_value FROM ( SELECT create_time, CAST(CASE WHEN number_text IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (digits IS NULL OR digits = '') OR decimal_order < -324 THEN '0' WHEN decimal_order > 308 OR (decimal_order = 308 AND digits >= '') THEN NULL WHEN decimal_order = 308 AND digits >= '17976931348623157' THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(number_text, 1, 1) = '-' THEN '-' ELSE '' END, '1.7976931348623157e308') ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(number_text, 1, 1) = '-' THEN '-' ELSE '' END, SUBSTR(digits, 1, 1), '.', SUBSTR(digits, 2, 18), 'e', CAST(decimal_order AS VARCHAR(20))) END AS DOUBLE) AS numeric_value FROM (SELECT create_time, number_text, digits, (CASE WHEN (exponent_digits IS NULL OR exponent_digits = '') THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(exponent_digits) > 6 THEN exponent_sign * 10000000 ELSE exponent_sign * CAST(exponent_digits AS INTEGER) END) + LENGTH(digits) - (CASE WHEN INSTR(coefficient, '.') > 0 THEN LENGTH(coefficient) - INSTR(coefficient, '.') ELSE 0 END) - 1 AS decimal_order FROM (SELECT create_time, number_text, coefficient, LTRIM(REPLACE(coefficient, '.', ''), '0') AS digits, LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(exponent_text, '+', ''), '-', ''), '0') AS exponent_digits, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(exponent_text, 1, 1) = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS exponent_sign FROM (SELECT create_time, number_text, REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN INSTR(number_text, 'e') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(number_text, 1, INSTR(number_text, 'e') - 1) ELSE number_text END, '+', ''), '-', '') AS coefficient, CASE WHEN INSTR(number_text, 'e') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(number_text, INSTR(number_text, 'e') + 1) ELSE '0' END AS exponent_text FROM (SELECT create_time, CASE WHEN LENGTH(original_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024 THEN CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(original_text, '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$') THEN LOWER(original_text) END END AS number_text FROM (SELECT create_time, TRIM(content) AS original_text FROM iot_device_log_metadata WHERE product_key = #{productKey} AND iot_id = #{iotId} AND message_type = 'PROPERTIES' AND property = #{property} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND create_time >= #{beginTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND create_time <= #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) raw_values) validated_values) split_values) decimal_parts) bounded_values ) finite_values ) trend_values GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
